description: This file defines a wizard interface for recording and stopping module recordings in OpenERP, including XML form definitions, functions to control recording state, and a wizard class with multiple states.

classes.name: base_module_publish
classes.description: A wizard interface class managing recording states for modules in OpenERP.

methods.name: _stop_recording
methods.description: Stops the recording by setting 'recording' to 0 in 'ir.module.record'.

methods.name: _start_recording
methods.description: Starts the recording by setting 'recording' to 1 and resetting data if not continuing.

methods.name: _check_recording
methods.description: Checks if recording is active and returns the next state accordingly.
